arms.D_equal_cap: C blocks clipped at prefixes to 200+200; unused quota from short source block transferred; total <=400

scope: Frozen queries/chunks/BM25. No gold, LLM or online rollout. Query-local needs only.
limitations: Same upper bound, not identical consumed tokens. Text-only budget excludes metadata.
Prefix clipping can cut sentences and discard query matches; this experiment evaluates this explicit allocation policy, not all multiblock methods.
Whitespace overlap retained verbatim and counted in each block; substantive overlap still excluded.
